title: Alwida Ay Hussain
body:
alwida ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dashte nainawa ay shaah e karbala
ay kushta e jafa ay deen ki baqa
alwida alwida alwida alwida
alwida ay khooni kafan
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe aqi pe kehte huwe ye behan chali
waada nibhane apna ghareebul watan chali
ay bekafan hussain tashna dahan hussain
dekho aseer hoke chali binte mustafa
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
utho ke taabe zabt ki quwwat nahi rahi
tumse bichad ke jeene ki hasrat nahi rahi
sultan e mashraqain quran ki zeb o zain
ruqsat ki aagayi hai ghadi aayat e khuda
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhai qaid e shaam nibhane chali ho mai
sang e sitam ka boj uthane chali hoo mai
tasveer e mustafa mehboob e kibriya
utho salaam e aakhri lelo ghareeb ka
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
karna dua ke pairon mein larzish kabhi na aaye
quwwat mein meri zarra barabar kami na aaye
zahra ke dilruba ay roohe murtaza
mai jaa rahi hoo uthke dua do mujhe zara
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kya karoo ke baazu hai bhaiya bandhe huwe
badthe hi jaa rahe hai masayib ke silsile
dushwaar hai dagar mushkil hai rah guzar
har ek qadam pe hoga masayib ka saamna
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hai tera haal pe charkhe kohan hussain
allah kya ghadi hai ke teri behan hussain
jaan kho nahi saki ro bhi nahi saki
ye daagh leke dil pe mai jaati hoo ba khuda
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwat to lo nigaahein to kholo shahe zaman
jumbish zara si lab ko to bolo shahe zaman
ay haami e safar yun tumko dekh kar
kaise kahe ki tumko ye ghamkhaar e benawa
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamaad e safar hai behan alwida hussain
jaati hai ab pahan ke rasan alwida hussain
zahra ke noor e ain qalb e ali ke chain
waada hai tumse waada nibhaungi mai sada
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
har gaam har maqaam pe ashke aza ke saath
ay bhai tujhse waada hai teri dua ke saath
abbas ki behan ay shaah e zulm e nan
ghurbat ka teri sab ko sunaungi marsiya
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise kahoo ke toot chuka hai ye dil mera
akbar ke gham ne mujhko zaeefa bana diya
kya kya karoo ayan kaise karoo bayan
gham ne tere labon ko hai ye marsiya diya
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam karo dua yehi yazdan ke roo baroo
mehfooz rakhna ay mere allah aabroo
hurmat ka hai sawaal ay rabbe zuljalaal
badta hi jaa raha hai masayib ka silisla
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
author: Dayam Najafi
